title: list_approvals input
description: Approval requests across decisions. view mine: pending requests that ask the person (their role, or their owner role on the decision's application, deputies too), the ones the engine's answer check lets them answer now first; a request a separation rule keeps them from answering comes after those, says why, and is not counted in answerableCount. asked-by-me: pending requests on decisions the person proposed, or on the decision of an intake or change they requested. open: every pending request. answered: the requests the person answered. Requests about an intake request the caller may not read are counted in couldNotRead (not in mine). Writes nothing; nothing here answers a request.

businessApplicationId.description: Only decisions about this application or its records.

portfolioId.description: Only the requests on decisions about applications in this portfolio, child portfolios included, or, for an intake request with no application yet, the intake's own portfolio. A portfolio that does not exist is refused.

decisionId.description: Only the requests on this decision, so a decision page finds the requests that ask the person whatever else is pending.
